title: notification first load not post action
rule: Notification is first-load page content, not a post-action pop-in — `role="region"`. Dynamic after interaction → InlineAlert. Dual-cite NSW in-page vs global alert.
pass_when: `Notification` is on the initial page load; post-action dynamic feedback uses InlineAlert.
fail_when: `Notification` is used as a post-interaction popup.
